population: Adult ICU severe sepsis / septic shock cases from India and age- and gender-matched healthy controls

unused_clinical_mimic_groups: None identified in current main dataset

population: Adult ICU sepsis and SIRS patients from UK hospitals plus healthy volunteers

unused_clinical_mimic_groups: SIRS day 1, day 2, day 5, and ICU discharge samples; potential future clinical mimic extension

population: Adult sepsis survivors and nonsurvivors with serial whole-blood samples plus healthy controls
